channel.description: Recent content in AfterTragedy on Pivtorak.Studio

item.title: 02-01 AfterTragedy. Delegitimation
item.description: Examination of how criminal governance disguises itself as lawful administration and how legitimacy is dismantled through accurate naming.

item.title: 02-02 AfterTragedy. System without Immunity
item.description: A diagnosis of institutional permeability, where violence encounters no resistance because the architecture itself no longer distinguishes between protection and threat.

item.title: 02-03 AfterTragedy. The Illusion of a Game
item.description: The work examines the illusion of political participation inside authoritarian regimes, where procedures become theatrical instruments masking predetermined outcomes and systemic repression.
